summary: EQL spell-icon mapping. Use this to verify per-spell icon assignments on the wiki.
findings: EQL's in-game spellbook renders icons from `Spells##.tga` sheets in `uifiles/default/`, NOT the 26 classic letter icons used by the wiki Spellicon_A..Z set.

The spell file's `new_icon` field is 0-indexed: `new_icon=0` is the first cell of Spells01.tga. Our extracted PNGs are 1-indexed (icon_0001.png = first cell), so the actual icon for a spell lives at icon_{new_icon+1:04d}.png.

1,043 verified in-game spells use 138 distinct icons spanning mostly Spells01-05.tga (~99% of spells), with 11 spells using cells in Spells06.tga and beyond (all verified as legitimate in-game icons via eqprog tooltips where available).

The wiki's 22-letter Spellicon set (A-V) maps multiple distinct in-game icons to the same letter (e.g., letter V groups 6 distinct cells including the green portal at cell 104 and the blue group-portal at cell 130). 4 letters (W,X,Y,Z) are unused.
Some in-game icons have NO wiki letter assigned (e.g., the blue group-portal used by Druid Circle teleports). The wiki spellicon= field is a lossy approximation, not a faithful map.

Recommend the wiki migrate spell-icon storage to numeric cell IDs (matching `new_icon+1`) or upload PNGs for the missing letters. Either way, this file is the authoritative per-spell mapping derived from EQL client data.

icon_addressing.cell_layout: 6 columns x 6 rows of 40x40 pixel cells per sheet (36 cells/sheet, 16px padding on right and bottom)
icon_addressing.spell_file_indexing: 0-indexed: new_icon=N refers to absolute cell N across all sheets
icon_addressing.addressing_math: sheet_num = N // 36 + 1; local = N % 36; row = local // 6; col = local % 6; pixel_box = (col*40, row*40, col*40+40, row*40+40)
icon_addressing.our_png_naming: icon_NNNN.png is 1-indexed (icon_0001.png = first cell). To look up a spell's icon: cell_id = new_icon + 1.
